findings.title: Exact multiples of the page size produce an extra empty page
findings.body: `totalPages` uses `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which is one too high whenever `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit`. For example, a group with 50 members and a limit of 50 displays two pages; clicking Next requests offset 50 and displays an empty member list. Use a ceiling division (for example `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)`) while retaining the explicit zero-member case.

findings.title: Out-of-order membership requests can replace the currently selected page
findings.body: Every `findMembers` completion unconditionally writes `offset`, `members`, and pagination metadata to the shared group model. A user can click Next and then Previous before the first request returns; if the Previous request completes first and the older Next request completes afterward, the stale Next response overwrites the first-page result and changes the displayed page back to the stale offset. Track/request-cancel the latest fetch (or verify the response offset/request token before applying it) so only the current request updates the model.

findings.title: The existing members endpoint response contract is changed incompatibly
findings.body: `GET /groups/:group_id/members` previously returned a serialized JSON array of users, but now returns an object containing `members` and `meta`. The in-repository Ember consumer was updated, but any other client, plugin, or API integration using this established endpoint will now fail when it attempts to iterate the top-level response. Preserve the array contract or introduce/version a metadata-aware endpoint before changing this response shape.
